body.x: Spaid (CEO Chongkul Yi) captured global attention at CES 2025 in Las Vegas. The company unveiled its award-winning image-based 3D geospatial metaverse solution, AI2RE (AI to Reality Engine), alongside its upcoming OpenAI-powered geospatial information platform, setting a new benchmark in geospatial AI innovation.

Spaid's AI2RE leverages a proprietary AI engine to extract 2D vector data from aerial imagery and transform it into 3D models of terrains, buildings, roads, and more. This solution addresses data loss and compatibility issues in traditional 3D cadastral map production, automating over 80% of the process and enabling swift, lossless data output. With applications spanning digital twin operations for smart cities, defense simulations, and real estate value analysis, AI2RE has become an essential tool for governments and corporations. Visitors to CES experienced a one-click demo showcasing object detection, 2D line extraction, and 3D model generation, which garnered enthusiastic responses.

body.cap: AI2RE Geospatial AI Solution │Provided by Spaid

body.x: Spaid also debuted its OpenAI-based geospatial information platform at the exhibition. This platform uses OpenAI agents to recommend customized geospatial data cards, which users can drag and drop to visualize and analyze on a 3D map viewer. By eliminating the need for complex software or tools, this intuitive solution significantly simplifies the use of geospatial data. At the CES booth, attendees explored a demo featuring 3D-visualized geospatial data cards from San Francisco, showcasing Spaid’s technological prowess.

Spaid has already demonstrated the efficiency of AI2RE in the European Union’s data management and utilization strategy project, reducing the time needed for cadastral map production from six months to just five days. The company is also in discussions for collaborations in South America and Africa, rapidly expanding its influence in the global market.

CEO Chongkul Yi expressed pride in Spaid’s innovation being recognized through the CES Innovation Award, stating, “This exhibition is an opportunity to showcase the excellence of our geospatial AI and metaverse solutions and accelerate our entry into global markets.”

body.x: Spaid connects physical and digital environments through data, driving innovation across smart cities, defense, finance, and telecommunications industries. With its CES 2025 presence, the company is setting a groundbreaking new standard for digital twins and geospatial AI.
